description_en: Queries the execution status of a task that modifies synchronization objects. This is a legacy operation
description_zh: 老版查询修改同步对象任务的执行状态
name: DescribeSynchronizationObjectModifyStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID, which is returned when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49451.html operation to modify synchronization objects
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49451.html接口修改同步对象时会返回该值
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id
